summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K announcing the resignation of CFO Jianchun Liu effective June 30, 2026, for personal reasons with no dispute, and the immediate appointment of Michael G. Potter as CFO effective May 26, 2026. Potter previously served as CFO of Corsair Gaming (2019-2025), leading its IPO and capital markets transactions, and held CFO roles at Canadian Solar and Lattice Semiconductor. The transition is orderly, with Liu remaining as principal advisor. This voluntary departure and prompt replacement represent a management change event. No deal terms apply.
